limitations: Finite fixtures do not establish arbitrary-input equivalence or whole-process RSS.
Checkpoint backing is newly reached beyond16 checkpoints even with tiny outputs; unavailable/full backing may fail queries that formerly completed without it.
No independent production throughput claim; fixture module I/O counts are separate from Rust temporary-float-store counters.
Foreign evidence executes the actual C checkpoint/backing module, not the entire Agent.
Prior Rust qualification keeps its unchanged source/binary identities; no broad expression corpus was rerun for this private C-only change.
Per-metric metadata still scales with selected series; failed/destroyed regions may remain until query close.

The unrelated backed-quantile fixture shows variable raw-read totals across unchanged-production-source runs with the same successful result/peak; preserved comparison counters do not establish equal throughput.
